description.narrative:
To provide necessary financial assistance to patients to ensure they can live with dignity until they return to their home country.
The issue of medical referrals for treatment is a significant problem in Palestine due to the lengthy procedures required to obtain these referrals. Often, this delay works against the patient’s interest, worsening their health condition, and sometimes resultingin death before the referral is obtained. This situation is exacerbated in the Gaza Strip due to more complicated procedures requiring occupation approval.
According to WAFA Agency regarding referrals for specialized treatment outside the Ministry of Health institutions, the total number of service purchase referrals from outside the Ministry of Health facilities in 2022 was 110,810 referrals, an increase of 11.8% from 2021, when the number was 99,064 referrals.
In 2022, the distribution of service purchase referrals bygender showed that 31,219 referrals (54.5%) were for male patients, while 26,041 referrals were for female patients. On average, each patient received about two referrals outside the Ministry of Health facilities.
In 2022, the increase in referrals outside Palestine was approximately 9.1% compared to the previous year.
Following the outbreak of the recent war on Gaza on October 7, 2023, several patients from Gaza, who were undergoing treatment in West Bank hospitals and hospitals inside Israel, were unable to return to the Gaza Strip. According to the Ministry of Social Development and through communication with the External Referral Department at the Ministry of Health and social workers at the directorates of social development in the governorates, a list was prepared containing approximately 350 patients, including women, men, and children, distributed across the following governorates: Ramallah, Bethlehem, Hebron, Jenin, and Nablus.

participating-org.narrative:
Rural Women#s Development Society (RWDS) is a Palestinian non-governmental organization working in the occupied West Bank and Gaza Strip. Founded in 1987 as the women#s group in Palestinian Agricultural Relief Committees (PARC), RWDS is now independentlyregistered with the Palestinian Authority under RA-287-C.
RWDS has a strong and respected grassroots presence in rural communities and 3000+women members in a network of 60 women#s clubs. Our unique structure, geographic breadth and large core of dedicated, grassroots volunteers distinguish RWDS from other Palestinian women#s organizations.
